name: leaf conditions remain implicitly ANDed
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      args_match: "^rm .*"
      path_pattern: "/etc/*"

name: all combines leaf conditions
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      all:
        - args_match: "^rm .*"
        - not:
            path_pattern: "/safe/*"

name: any matches when one child matches
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      any:
        - path_pattern: "/etc/*"
        - args_match: "^echo .*"

name: empty all is true
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      all: []

name: empty any is false
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      any: []

name: time window includes its start
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      time_window:
        start: "2026-08-11T12:00:00Z"
        end: "2026-08-11T13:00:00Z"

name: time window excludes its end
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      time_window:
        start: "2026-08-11T12:00:00Z"
        end: "2026-08-11T13:00:00Z"

name: not negates a time window
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      not:
        time_window:
          start: "2026-08-11T12:00:00Z"
          end: "2026-08-11T13:00:00Z"

name: time window composes with existing leaves
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      args_match: "^rm .*"
      time_window:
        start: "2026-08-11T12:00:00Z"
        end: "2026-08-11T13:00:00Z"

name: boolean operator cannot mix with leaf fields
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      all: []
      args_match: "^ok$"

name: not requires one condition mapping
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      not: null

name: time windows reject non UTC offsets
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      time_window:
        start: "2026-08-11T12:00:00+01:00"
        end: "2026-08-11T13:00:00Z"

name: time windows require exactly start and end
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      time_window:
        start: "2026-08-11T12:00:00Z"
        end: "2026-08-11T13:00:00Z"
        timezone: UTC

name: time windows require a positive interval
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      time_window:
        start: "2026-08-11T13:00:00Z"
        end: "2026-08-11T12:00:00Z"

name: unknown boolean operator is rejected
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      and: []
